notes:
Consistency pass on staging: back link, headings, help block, cards, filters, waves, spacing

The owner's answers to the site consistency audit (docs/mockups/site-consistency-audit.html),
built on staging13 on 2026-11-22. Answers, brand colours and the state of each topic are in
docs/working-notes/tcc-consistency-approvals.md; the brand guide is in docs/brand/.

- Page heading: one back link (arrow and the page above, or Home) in place of the
  Home > ... > page trail, on every page and template (TCC Website Features 0.8.0 to 0.8.2,
  with a guard so WP Rocket keeps its styles).
- Heading sizes 36 / 26 / 22px on 37 pages and in ten Theme Builder layouts; one small
  capital label style; #007DA1 removed from the site.
- One shared "Can't find what you are looking for?" block (Divi Library 250206) on 33 pages.
- One grey card and standard corners; date in a teal line above the title; "Show 12 more"
  on Events, Community Groups and Trinity Talk; one grey filter bar.
- Line pattern and inner-page wave edges removed; gradient invitation cards; question lists
  and form boxes aligned; section spacing evened out.
- TCC Website Features 0.9.0 to 0.9.5, with the Help tab and AI prompts updated.
- Scripts that made each page change, and every page and layout as it was before, are in
  divi-exports/consistency-pass/ and divi-exports/back-link/.

Also includes two pieces from an earlier session that were already on staging: the menu hover
change (0.7.2, no wait between menu buttons) and the Triads Book Lists card on Resources.

Nothing on the live site was changed.
